Captured excerpts, 2026-10-22: Pair#773 recorded suite attempt
`1d8fae6745226f7d80414d02eccb7c87` (script timeout, tracked by pair#685),
and Parley#410 operator native run (o-entry case, tracked by parley.nvim#412).
Terminal bytes, including native Plenary color and CR, are preserved.

These historical diagnostics do not contain typed observer events or private
